# SPD-044 — Bash hook: a VCS alias defined on the command line with -c alias.NAME=VERB runs a write verb under a name Law 7's table does not hold

## Brief
git_verb skips -c and its value and reads the next word as the verb; git expands an alias defined by -c alias.NAME=VERB (or GIT_CONFIG_* variables, or a !shell alias) before running it, so a member's write runs under NAME, which git_refused does not refuse. Pre-existing, not a glob; found probing SPD-041.

Evidence: Read-only probe from the scratchpad: the VCS binary run with -c alias.v=version v printed its version (2.50.1, Apple Git-155), so the alias is expanded from -c. The hook reads the same shape with a write verb behind the alias (-c alias.p=push p) as verb p, not refused, on this branch and before it (scratchpad edge_probe.py). Fix sketch: when -c (or --config-env, or GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY/VALUE in the line) defines alias.*, refuse a member, or read the alias's value as the verb and a leading ! as a shell command.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, no children: one hook fix in bin/spud_ledger.py (git_verb and the git branch of analyse_segment) with red-first tests in tests/test_hooks.py, the same shape as SPD-040 and SPD-041, built in worktree spd-044-git-config-alias. No git aliases are configured in Eric's git config today (git config --get-regexp alias. is empty), so the hole is the command-line and environment forms.

## Outcome
A member's git call is now refused under Law 7 when its own line defines a git alias or include with -c or --config-env (spaced and = forms, sections alias, include and includeIf, case-folded), or injects config through GIT_CONFIG, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS or GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n/VALUE_n by prefix, export or env. Non-alias config stays silent and Spud is unaffected. GitConfigAliasTest, 11 methods, red first (84 failures). Differential over 1,878 pre-change strings: none changed. Suite 533 OK, rerun by Spud. Merged into main. Proposals became SPD-046 (P1, widened to every config key and environment variable git runs as a program, core.pager included) and SPD-047 (P2, widened to HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME).
